descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime LC 360 ARGB CPU Liquid Cooler


Maximize your system's performance with the ASUS Prime LC 360 ARGB CPU Liquid Cooler, engineered to deliver elite, whisper-quiet thermal management for the latest high-end Intel and AMD processors.


Key Features:

• Advanced 360mm Radiator: Equipped with three 120mm ARGB fans to ensure optimal airflow and superior heat dissipation under heavy gaming or rendering workloads.

• Vibrant ARGB Lighting: Features stunning, fully customizable addressable RGB lighting that syncs effortlessly with your motherboard to elevate your gaming setup's aesthetics.

• High-Performance Pump: Optimized motor design that minimizes operational noise while maximizing coolant flow rate for stable, low CPU temperatures.

• Reinforced Sleeved Tubing: Durable and flexible tubing built to prevent evaporation and leaks, ensuring long-term reliability and a safer build environment.


Invest in your PC's stability and maintain peak frame rates during intense gaming and content creation with premium ASUS Prime liquid cooling!

Key Features

  • Specially designed CPU contact area with finned channels for more efficient heat transfer, helping the CPU maintain optimal temperatures even under heavy workloads without thermal throttling
  • Single Y-cable connects both ARGB lighting and fans, simplifying cable management
  • Customizable infinity mirror lenses let users personalize the aesthetic of their build
  • Designed to visually complement ASUS Prime motherboards

Bottom line: A clean, well-rounded 360mm AIO with Asetek pump reliability, daisy-chain ARGB fans, and a copper cold plate — a solid mid-range cooler that pairs naturally with ASUS Prime builds. If you want a live temperature display on the pump head, step up to the LCD variant.
